reason: The original Anari question asks for a polynomial-time absolute exponential determinant-ratio approximation for every accretive matrix and every k. This PR proves such an algorithm only when rank(L)<=k+1, with a complete rational-bit supplement and singular/zero/skew branches. Its fixed-radius Hadamard local-optimum obstruction rules out only that method, and the second-compound negative direction rules out only a PSD cofactor extension. Neither is a counterexample to the requested general algorithm. Rank>=k+2 remains explicitly unresolved. Source repairs, conditional imports and the known general k^O(k) baseline do not close that gap.
